hero.title: Stop the cloned-voice call before the money moves.
hero.subtitle: Real-time AI anti-spoofing paired with family voiceprint verification, instant safe-word challenge, and automatic cooling-off payment locks.

threeSteps.title: How Voice Secure Protects in 3 Real-Time Steps
threeSteps.step1Desc: Listens in 3-second sliding windows and computes an on-device acoustic risk score (0 to 1) for AI voice synthesis artifacts.
threeSteps.step2Desc: Cross-references voice biometrics against consent-enrolled family voiceprints and checks caller ID against your trusted circle.
threeSteps.step3Desc: Instantly challenges with a confidential family safe word, enforces a UPI payment cooling lock, and broadcasts family alerts.

comparison.title: What Makes Voice Secure Different
